title: Your First Weekend at John Carroll University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend loop: get oriented, find useful campus landmarks, and make one nearby cultural outing.

cards.title: Start by finding the Main Quad
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Use the Main Quad as your outdoor reference point, then follow campus paths to the library, student center, chapel, and nearby academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A central landmark for beginning an on-foot campus loop.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s interactive campus map lists Main Quad as a campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Make Grasselli Library your reset point
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · study and support stop
cards.notes: Walk through the library early so you know where to return for quiet study, research help, a book, or a low-key break between activities.
cards.short_summary: A campus library and learning-center stop for settling in.
cards.evidence_claim: Grasselli Library and Breen Learning Center invites students to use its collections and spaces for research, quiet study, reading, and games.
cards.source_title: Grasselli Library & Breen Learning Center | John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current access information before visiting.

cards.title: Take a short pause in the Reading Garden
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · outdoor pause near Grasselli
cards.notes: After locating the library, step outside to the named Reading Garden for a brief breather before continuing your campus walk and meeting new people.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor landmark beside the library portion of the loop.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s interactive campus map lists Grasselli Reading Garden among campus landmarks.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use normal campus pathways and posted rules.

cards.title: Locate the Lombardo Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · student-life anchor
cards.notes: Find the Student Center early and look for current campus information there; it is a useful landmark for returning to student-life spaces during the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A named student-life destination on the campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s interactive campus map lists Lombardo Student Center under dining and student life.
cards.access_notes: Check building access and scheduled programming on arrival.

cards.title: Find Schott Dining Hall before dinner plans
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · dining-location check
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate Schott Dining Hall, then check current dining information before relying on it for a meal during your first weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s interactive campus map lists Schott Dining Hall under dining and student life.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current dining service and payment options before visiting.

cards.title: Add Saint Francis Chapel to your bearings
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus landmark
cards.notes: Pass by Saint Francis Chapel while learning the academic side of campus, and check Campus Ministry information if you want to attend an appropriate service or program.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark that can orient a walking route.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s interactive campus map lists Saint Francis Chapel as a campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Observe posted access guidance and the chapel’s scheduled-use information.

cards.title: See where recreation and events happen
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · activity-space orientation
cards.notes: Locate the Athletic, Wellness & Event Center and check its current recreation or event access details before planning a workout, game, or campus program.
cards.short_summary: A new campus facility for athletics, wellness, recreation, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll reports that its Athletic, Wellness & Event Center includes an indoor track, multi-purpose courts, training areas, classrooms, and event space.
cards.source_title: John Carroll Celebrates Grand Opening of New Athletic, Wellness & Event Center | John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Confirm current student and visitor access before entering or using facilities.

cards.title: Identify Shula Stadium on the south side
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · athletics landmark
cards.notes: Walk past Shula Stadium as part of your campus loop, then check the athletics schedule if you want to attend a suitable future game or campus event.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed athletic facility that helps anchor the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll’s interactive campus map lists Shula Stadium among athletic facilities.
cards.access_notes: View from public campus routes; event entry and access vary.

cards.title: Check the current student-events calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · choose an organized activity
cards.notes: Look for the current student-programming options and choose one that fits your schedule; JCU describes recurring movie, craft, bingo, and organized outing options.
cards.short_summary: A practical way to turn the weekend into a shared campus activity.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll says its student events and excursions can include movie, craft, and bingo nights as well as organized off-campus outings.
cards.source_title: Student Groups & Activities | John Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Programming, eligibility, registration, and costs vary; consult the current JCU calendar.

cards.title: Save a free museum visit for Sunday
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime · University Circle cultural outing
cards.notes: Plan a daytime visit to the permanent-collection galleries, then use the museum’s visitor page to confirm hours, entry procedures, and any ticketed exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A nearby cultural stop with free general admission to permanent galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cleveland Museum of Art states that general admission to its permanent collection galleries is always free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Cleveland Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; Wednesday and Friday 10 a.m.–9 p.m.; closed Monday. Ticketed exhibitions may cost extra.
